verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's own docs cite an ecosystem of 23,600+ modules and 3,900+ providers. They describe configuration you can "version, reuse, and share," with centralized module version management, which implies you can consume reusable modules. Nothing in the evidence explicitly names a public registry or documents how to publish a module to one. missing for 10: explicit public registry documentation, module publishing workflow, registry source/versioning syntax for consumption, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can consume and publish reusable modules or components from a public registry

citations.quote: With a thriving ecosystem of 3,900+ providers and 23,600+ modules, you can build and manage infrastructure across every cloud platform with confidence.
